assets.title: Open Divided Mail Satchel
assets.description: One original static postal satchel with a genuine open thick-walled tapered shell, visible finite cavity floors and one solid divider forming two empty mail compartments. A wide rear-attached flap is held in one raised pose. A continuous thick single shoulder strap has two individually seated side anchors and brass rivets. Eight named closed editable meshes have measured support connections to a finite flat base; both cavities and the shoulder opening have actual full-assembly clear rays. Four constant solid PBR materials, metre scale, native Z up, ground-centre origin and presentation front -Y. No textures, logos, letters or external assets. One visual prop only; no capacity, load, human fit, postal specification, weatherproofing, soft-body, opening or carrying animation, manufacture or safety claim.
